added: packages/event-ingestion (@sos-2/event-ingestion): the Observation Plane ingestion boundary. The eight §5 input families (github repository/webhook events, ci/build/test/security events, deployment events, runtime telemetry, incidents/provider health, scheduled probes, explicit user observations) as typed EventSourcePort adapters; normalization composes the DURABLE replay-protection event id deterministically from (source, externalId) — the same redelivered external event is the same id forever, so replay protection works across redelivery storms; payloads are opaque canonical-JSON preserved VERBATIM (truth states inside payloads survive ingestion bit-exact, never folded into success or zero — the P2 opaque-payload rule). The ingestion pipeline wraps the P2 ObservationEventRepository.ingest contract: APPLIED / typed DUPLICATE (durable index, never double-applied) / typed REJECTED for malformed inputs (the plane keeps running, a broken event never poisons it). Source health is per-source typed bookkeeping (last event, applied/duplicate/rejected/poll-failure counters — clock-injected, no hidden time). The ProbeScheduler runs scheduled probes ONLY where the CoverageLedger reports organic coverage insufficient (SKIPPED_COVERED when coverage returns — probes stand down; every probe envelope carries the scheduled-probe family so probe evidence is always distinguishable from organic coverage). The CoverageLedger reports COVERED_FRESH / COVERED_STALE / PROBE_ONLY / NOT_COVERED per (subject, family).

packages/observation (@sos-2/observation): the no-body observation core. LIVE PROJECTIONS — deterministic folds over the durable observation-event stream (repository branch heads + open pull requests, latest CI runs per pipeline, deployed revisions per environment, provider health last signals), rebuilt from events on every read, never stored as canonical state; every projection carries an explicit FreshnessMark (FRESH/STALE/NO_DATA — stale is always distinguishable from success), a malformedEvents counter (malformed payloads are counted and skipped, never crash the fold, never silently project) and foldedEventIds (evidence binding). RECONCILIATION — System State claims are consumed through a READ-ONLY claims port and compared to observed revisions producing typed findings: ALIGNED / DIVERGED (expected vs observed) / UNVERIFIED (no observation wired) / STALE (observation older than the freshness window — its own truthful state, never reported as aligned). DETECTION — shortfalls and opportunities as non-authoritative typed records (CI_FAILING_ON_HEAD, DEPLOYED_NOT_AT_HEAD, STATE_DIVERGED, REVISION_UPDATE_AVAILABLE) each bound to evidence event ids; revision ordering is NEVER asserted (shas are opaque — only difference is claimed, with evidence). The ObservationLoop runs one bounded drain (poll+ingest sources -> run due probes -> poll telemetry -> project -> reconcile -> detect) driven by the host's injected tick; no ambient timers; no body, no harness, no network anywhere in the package.

packages/telemetry-runtime (@sos-2/telemetry-runtime): the poll-driven host side of runtime telemetry ingestion. Pulls wired W3 TelemetrySource ports on the loop's ticks and converts every RawObservation capture into a replay-protected observation event through the P7 pipeline — carrying the capture VERBATIM so capture-level availability truth states (SUCCESS/FAILURE/UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE/UNSUPPORTED/PARTIAL) survive bit-exact (gaps stay gaps). Event ids are deterministic per (source, capture ordinal): redelivering the same buffer produces the same ids and deduplicates exactly. A source whose fetch() throws records a typed POLL_FAILED outcome — the runtime does NOT fabricate a gap observation for a failed pull (a gap asserts data absence; a failed pull asserts neither — conflating them would be dishonest).

apps/observation (@sos-2/observation-host): the composition root. A plain Node + TypeScript host (repo-standard ESM + tsc build, no vendor framework — the apps/api + apps/worker-runtimes precedent) assembling the durable in-memory P2 live-store + P7 pipeline + telemetry runtime + projections + read-only claims port + detection + loop with EVERYTHING injected; the composition root is the single impure boundary (SystemClock via Date.now — the documented exception; everything deeper is deterministic and offline-testable). Reference event sources are deterministic scripted adapters with explicit simulated markers; notYetConnectedSource reports the honest NOT_YET_CONNECTED status and its poll fails with a typed reason naming it — real provider endpoints (GitHub webhook receivers, CI buses, deployment trackers, telemetry backends) attach later behind the same ports, connection evidence never fabricated. The demo main runs ONE bounded drain over the scripted reference events (the external topology drives the same drain on its own ticks).

tests/observation (@sos-2/observation-contracts): the acceptance suites pinning the work-order acceptance end-to-end over the public composition: a complete observation loop runs with NO body active (the full §5 family set ingested, projected, reconciled and detected in one drain; the task and body-lease stores stay empty); GitHub push/PR events update live projections (push moves the branch head, PR open/close updates the open set); runtime/CI evidence preserves truth states and provenance (an UNAVAILABLE telemetry capture stays UNAVAILABLE end-to-end; every event carries provenance); stale/unavailable is distinguishable from success (FRESH->ALIGNED, beyond-window->STALE, no-observation->UNVERIFIED, failed polls are typed POLL_FAILED never fabricated success); observation events are replay-safe (full redelivery storm double-applies nothing; deterministic telemetry capture ids deduplicate exactly); observation does not mutate semantic truth (write-counting wrappers on every domain repository prove a full drain writes ONLY the observation-event store); plus structural scans: no forbidden ambient calls (Date.now/Math.random/fetch/process.env/timers/child_process/require) in the owned sources outside the documented apps/observation composition boundary (system-clock.ts + the demo main), imports restricted to merged + P7-owned workspace packages, reference sources report simulated while real endpoints report not-yet-connected.
preserved_invariants: the frozen W0-W18 core and every merged wave file remain untouched: all changes are additive under the owned paths packages/event-ingestion, packages/observation, packages/telemetry-runtime, apps/observation and tests/observation; spec/, docs/, scripts/, .github/, pnpm-workspace.yaml and every existing packages/*, apps/*, infra/* and tests/* source are byte-identical to the base head 86a6921631113167f071c2f9019dddd0c1ab6447

observation NEVER mutates semantic truth outside authoritative domain stores: the loop reads the observation-event store and writes only its own derived projections/findings (in-memory); the System State is consumed through a READ-ONLY claims port; pinned by write-counting wrappers over every domain repository in tests/observation (missions, contexts, systemStates, evidence, architecture, candidates, assurance, experiments, decisions, authorityGrants, packages, history, developmentState, tasks, bodyLeases — all zero writes across full drains)

the Semantic Spine remains the ONLY identity/envelope/kind/trace/serialization authority: P7 packages mint no spine ids, register no artifact kinds and define no trace types; observation event ids are P2 delivery-level replay-protection keys (source:externalId — runtime identifiers, not semantic identity); projections and findings are derived views with deterministic content-based ids, never stored as canonical state; canonical semantics remain in the authoritative domain stores (§5: 'Redis/queues may coordinate delivery, but canonical semantics remain in durable stores')

stale and unavailable observation is always distinguishable from success: every projection carries an explicit FreshnessMark (FRESH/STALE/NO_DATA); reconciliation findings separate ALIGNED from STALE from UNVERIFIED; telemetry captures preserve capture-level availability bit-exact (an UNAVAILABLE capture stays UNAVAILABLE through the entire pipeline); failed polls are typed POLL_FAILED outcomes with honest reasons — never fabricated success and never conflated with data-absence gaps

observation events are replay-safe: the durable event id is composed deterministically from (source, externalId) so redelivery deduplicates exactly through the P2 durable index (typed DUPLICATE, never double-applied); telemetry capture ids are deterministic per (source, ordinal); pinned by redelivery-storm tests over the full composition

scheduled probes are the honest fallback, not a masquerade: the ProbeScheduler runs a probe only while the CoverageLedger reports organic coverage insufficient for its (subject, family), stands down (SKIPPED_COVERED) when coverage returns, enforces the minimum interval, and every probe-produced event carries the scheduled-probe family so downstream consumers always distinguish probe evidence from organic event/telemetry coverage (the work-order rule: use scheduled probes only where event/telemetry coverage is insufficient)

honest statuses are never fabricated: reference sources report the explicit simulated marker; real provider endpoints report NOT_YET_CONNECTED and their polls fail with typed reasons naming it; no event is ever synthesized for an unconnected or failed source; provider health signals report what the feed said, nothing more

the user device is optional (§7) and bodies are replaceable mechanisms (§1): the complete observation loop runs with ZERO body, harness, task or body-lease presence (pinned: the task and body-lease stores stay empty through full drains) — continuous governance does not require a permanent coding agent (§5)

zero new external dependencies (runtime or dev): every dependency of the five new packages is a workspace:* link and every devDependency is the repository's existing toolchain (@types/node, typescript, vitest — already resolved by the base pnpm-lock.yaml for the existing suites); pnpm-lock.yaml and pnpm-workspace.yaml remain unchanged in the committed diff (the new packages join through the already-globbed packages/*, apps/* and tests/* paths — the P5/P8 precedent)

determinism and offline execution: no Date.now, Math.random, fetch, process.env, ambient timers, child_process or require in any owned package source outside the single documented apps/observation composition boundary (system-clock.ts + the demo main — the apps/api precedent); clocks, repositories, sources, claims and wiring are injected; ids and event ids are deterministic compositions; every suite runs offline with the repository's fixed vitest seed (pinned by structural scans)
